scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');const d='apps/kpp-cli/src';const has=fs.existsSync(d)&&fs.readdirSync(d,{recursive:true}).some(f=>f.endsWith('.ts'));if(has)cp.execFileSync('tsc',['-p','apps/kpp-cli/tsconfig.json'],{stdio:'inherit'});else console.log('No CLI sources yet; skipping TypeScript emit');"
